West Indies Cricketers Powell and Rutherford Penalized by ICC

West Indies cricketers Rovman Powell and Sherfane Rutherford have been penalized by the International Cricket Council (ICC) for breaching the code of conduct during a match in Ranchi. Both players received one demerit point each and a reprimand.
